![](/images/projects/nlp-packages.jpg){fig-alt="Rhetorical Adaptation in Political Speech figure"}

This project asks how political figures such as Bernie Sanders, JD Vance and Ron DeSantis adjust their language and sentiment depending on context: rallies, Senate floor speeches and bipartisan settings.

## What we built

- Three installable Python packages (data collection, preprocessing, utils) managed with Poetry and covered by pytest
- A config-driven speech downloader that scrapes transcripts by politician and category
- A text cleaner that keeps proper nouns, numbers and sentence structure for linguistic analysis
- Notebooks for EDA, Stanza-based linguistic features, n-gram extraction and sentiment analysis

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}

- **Course:** DSAN 5400 Computational Linguistics, Georgetown University

- **Team:** Team project with Erin Brzusek, Vinny Turtora, Sebastian Villalobos and Nikhil Patla
- **Tools:** Python, NLTK, Stanza, sentiment analysis, n-grams, Poetry, pytest
